material_findings.title: Builder.io Agent-Native Hackathon: $10,000 verified cash pool with conflicting official submission deadlines
material_findings.summary: Sponsor rules state free entry, adults worldwide subject to exclusions, Oct 27 start, Nov 9 2026 11:59 PM Pacific submission deadline, and USD 5000/2500/1500/750/250 cash awards. The live sponsor submission form contradicts the rules and displays Nov 2 2026 11:59 PM Pacific. Earlier cached/search result also gave Oct 19 start and Nov 2 deadline; current rules and homepage instead give Oct 27 start and Nov 9 deadline. Do not treat Nov 9 as operationally safe until sponsor confirms or fixes the form. No preregistration or live attendance required. New or meaningfully changed Agent-Native app and publicly accessible Clips demo required; public code repository optional. Framework GitHub repo is public and MIT-licensed; local installation, demo recording and any infrastructure cost untested.
material_findings.eligibility: 18+ or legal majority if higher; lawful jurisdictions; sponsor/judging conflicts excluded; participant eligibility not verified

deadline_conflict.recommended_safe_planning: Treat Nov 2 23:59 PT as conservative operational cutoff unless sponsor confirms Nov 9 and the submission form is corrected.

material_findings.next_action: Ask sponsor at hackathon@builder.io to reconcile deadline immediately; inspect actual submission form acceptance window; verify Clips and framework setup; then build only genuinely in-window new work and preserve submission receipt.

material_findings.summary: Oct 25 preprint describes author-reported 22.5%-56% attack success across six coding agents by renaming identifiers in untrusted code; no instructions or vulnerable statements in bait.
